 Camryn Rabideau 2026년 11월 21일 토 오전 6:00 UTC 0 If this sunscreen good enough for Sydney, Emma, and Kendall, it's good enough for me. (Getty) Quick Overview
 EltaMD UV Clear Untinted Face Sunscreen, SPF 46
 $62 $78 Save $16 See at Amazon EltaMD UV Skin Recovery Green Tinted 100% Mineral Sunscreen, SPF 50
 $42 $53 Save $11 See at Amazon EltaMD UV Clear Tinted Face Sunscreen, SPF 46
 $18 $25 Save $6 See at Amazon EltaMD UV Clear SPF 46 Holiday Gift Set
 $32 $40 Save $8 See at Amazon It's rare that celebrities of all ages agree on "holy grail" skincare products — and when they do, it's even rarer that it's something I can afford. (Let's be honest: I will not be shelling out $400 for La Mer moisturizer.) However, there's one product that you'll find in the daily routine of nearly every Hollywood icon: EltaMD sunscreen . 
 This affordable sunscreen has been lauded by everyone from Kendall Jenner to Sydney Sweeney, who praise its lightweight, easy-to-wear consistency. It's not just beloved by young stars, either — the sunscreen is also a staple among the over-50 crowd, earning its spot in the routines of Gwyneth Paltrow, Kyle Richards, and Brooks Shields. Plus, it's the No. 1 dermatologist-recommended professional sunscreen brand out there today, and with all that going for it, I simply had to try it for myself. 
 After just a few days of use, I officially understood the hype. It's by far the most lightweight, non-greasy formula I've ever tried — it basically feels like a second skin, and it wears phenomenally on its own or underneath makeup. I've been more consistent about wearing sunscreen daily ever since I switched, and I'll definitely be grabbing a second bottle while it's on sale for Black Friday . 
 Advertisement
 Amazon
 EltaMD UV Clear Untinted Face Sunscreen, SPF 46 $62 $78 Save $16 UV Clear, which offers SPF 46 protection, is the lightest sunscreen I've ever tried, and it's not sticky at all. It doesn't leave a white cast, and it works well on its own or underneath my everyday makeup. The brand doesn't go on sale often, so you're going to want to stock up while it's marked down for Black Friday — I know I am!
 $62.40 at Amazon What the celebs say
 You don't just have to take my word that this sunscreen is the best. The formula has been racking up praise for years, and many A-list celebrities consider it a staple in their everyday beauty routines.
 "I'm a long-time user of the EltaMD sunscreen line," Brooke Shields , 61, told Elle . "I always apply in the morning and one time during the day. I even use a thin layer before putting it on my foundation."
 "I cannot say enough good things about this," said TV personality Kyle Richards , 57, on an Amazon Live stream. “All of my daughters use this. All of the girls on my show use this. I was first introduced to it by a doctor and then I started seeing it everywhere."
 "I love this EltaMD sunscreen, and I know Kourtney uses it," Khloe Kardashian , 42 , said in a Vogue video interview. "I put this on my face, my hands, my neck, my chest because this is where we all show our age. I like to let that sit in for a minute before I moisturize."
 "I'm grateful that sunblock exists; otherwise, I'd be screwed," Emma Stone, 38, told Glamour .
 “A lot of sunscreens make my skin break out and this one has been my holy grail,” model Hailey Bieber , 29, said in an Elle video  a few years ago.
 Actress Sydney Sweeney , 28, echoed this sentiment, telling Vogue it's “the only sunscreen I’ve found that doesn’t break me out.”
 "I love how this sunscreen makes me feel fresh and beautiful," actress Julianne Hough , 38, told E! News .
 "I love this — I've been using it for years," supermodel Kendall Jenner , 30, told Vogue .
 Celebs of all ages have lauded this sunscreen for its lightweight formula. While the EltaMD UV Clear is by far the most popular formula, there are several other options to choose from, depending on your skincare needs. They're all marked down for the sale, so now is the time to try it out for yourself — I promise you won't be disappointed!
 Amazon
 EltaMD UV Skin Recovery Green Tinted 100% Mineral Sunscreen, SPF 50 $42 $53 Save $11 You can instantly neutralize the look of skin redness with this green-tinted 100% mineral sunscreen, which has an easily blendable texture that absorbs quickly into the skin.

 EltaMD UV Clear Tinted Face Sunscreen, SPF 46 $18 $25 Save $6 This tinted face sunscreen with transparent Zinc Oxide provides broad spectrum SPF 46 protection. It also contains Niacinamide, which helps to improve skin tone and reduce the appearance of discoloration and blemishes on the skin.
